Quarterly inventory report

This is an ordinary public page. It exists so the L0 lane can prove that a real document is read, not mistaken for a block page. The warehouse ended the quarter with 1,284 units across four locations, which is 6% above plan.

Row 1: 12 units. Row 2: 7 units. Row 3: 31 units. Row 4: 4 units. Row 5: 18 units. Row 6: 22 units. Row 7: 9 units. Row 8: 15 units.

Notes: the north dock was closed for two weeks while its floor was resurfaced, so its receipts were shifted to the east dock. Nothing else in the process changed. The next count is scheduled for the first week of the coming quarter, and the same team will run it.
